recommendation: Keep the source change. It completes the missed narrative portion of FHIR-10647 and keeps ContactPoint.system aligned with later final decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-10647 was a Published/Persuasive datatypes request to restore ContactPoint.system code url, define it for non-phone/fax/pager/email contacts expressed as URLs, redefine other for contacts not expressible as URLs, and change other display to Other.
initial_application: Commit 2ea2f88f92ad35028521ebd3e595f50daa73990e restored url and revised the code definitions in source/datatypes/contactpoint.xml. The narrative in source/datatypes.html still told readers to use system other for URL-style contacts, leaving a semantic inconsistency.
additional_context: FHIR-6089 was the earlier issue that renamed url to other. FHIR-12684 later added sms. FHIR-32004, FHIR-36033, and FHIR-39154 are later no-change decisions that rely on url, other, and extensions rather than relaxing the required code binding or adding technology-specific codes.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes.html so URL-expressible contact points use system url with a URL value, while contacts not expressible as URLs use system other and may need human interpretation or extensions. The required code list was not changed.
source_changes: source/datatypes.html: updated the ContactPoint narrative to direct URL-expressible contacts to system "url" and non-URL contacts to system "other", and corrected stale http{s}: wording in the same sentence.
